title: Purified argon made by hand docked at the Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) from argon bought there, sold into its bid, the rest stored
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: the traders left at the capitals after the once lines take standing work there, docked NPC-facility crafting; rules F8, F23, O1 zero empty burn). 34 traders wait docked at the Crimson War Citadel after Krynn's once lines (fill.py status trader 18:25 UTC: 64 trader waiting). The Citadel's book (table books, 18:43 UTC): argon_gas asked at 1 cr, purified_argon bid at 1 cr x 942 (the station's). purify_argon by hand: 5 argon_gas -> 3 purified_argon a run; a run costs about 5.0 cr and sells for 3 cr while the bid holds: crafting XP for about 2.0 cr a run, no fuel, no jump. requires.docked_at keeps it to a ship already docked there (no trip). No requires.bid: what the bid does not take is stored, so the route stays open when the 1 cr bid is drained; purified_argon is no reserve good (game/reserve.tsv, needs.tsv). standing: XP work, never judged on its pay. Three crafts beside it (argon, neon, oxygen) split the 34 ships over three bids. 2026-11-23 19:07 UTC (Mercury): the third craft stop keeps the ship docked on desk watch for 20 minutes (watch_minutes, 0 fuel): a run of 24 to 36 crafts costs about 74 to 122 cr once the 1 cr bids are drained, so the watch halves the burn of the standing crafts while every ship stays at work (orders ENT-083 block MERCURY, P1 pay for itself); measured in flight (F37) and tuned next turn. 2026-11-23 19:10 UTC (Mercury): status off: reservecheck.py --plan trader FLAGged the sale (rule F24): purified argon is a reserve good (recursion, resonance miner needs; pull.json held 36 of max 57), never sold. craft-sell-nitrogen-krynn takes its 12 ships: liquid nitrogen stands above its max, its sale is surplus.
